# pvecli sdn unlock

Release a stale global SDN lock left by another session.

```text
pvecli sdn unlock [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
